374:     name: str  # LHS symbol
375:     expression: str  # VERBATIM Mathematica RHS
376:     delayed: bool = False  # True -> ":=", False -> "="
377: 
378:     @model_validator(mode="after")
379:     def _check(self) -> "LagrangianTerm":
380:         _require_balanced(self.expression, f"lagrangian term {self.name}")
381:         return self
382: 
383: 
384: def _references(text: str, name: str) -> bool:
385:     """True if ``name`` appears in ``text`` as a whole Mathematica token."""
386:     if not text:
387:         return False
388:     return re.search(rf"(?<![A-Za-z0-9$]){re.escape(name)}(?![A-Za-z0-9$])", text) is not None
389: 
390: 
391: def _param_refs(p: Parameter, names: set) -> set:
392:     """Names of other parameters referenced by ``p``'s value/rules/definitions."""
393:     texts: List[str] = []
394:     if p.value:
395:         texts.append(p.value)
396:     for r in p.value_rules:
397:         texts.append(r.rhs)
398:     for r in p.definitions:
399:         texts.append(r.rhs)
400:     blob = " ".join(texts)
401:     return {n for n in names if n != p.name and _references(blob, n)}
402: 
403: 
404: def topo_sort_parameters(params: List[Parameter]) -> List[Parameter]:
405:     """Order parameters so each is defined before others that reference it.
406: 
407:     Stable (preserves input order among independent params). Raises on a
408:     dependency cycle.
409:     """
410:     names = {p.name for p in params}
411:     deps = {p.name: _param_refs(p, names) for p in params}
412:     by_name = {p.name: p for p in params}
413: 
414:     ordered: List[Parameter] = []
415:     emitted: set = set()
416:     remaining = [p.name for p in params]  # preserve input order
417: 
418:     while remaining:
419:         progressed = False
420:         still: List[str] = []
421:         for n in remaining:
422:             if deps[n] <= emitted:
423:                 ordered.append(by_name[n])
424:                 emitted.add(n)
425:                 progressed = True
426:             else:
427:                 still.append(n)
428:         remaining = still
429:         if not progressed:
430:             raise ValueError(
431:                 f"cyclic parameter dependency among: {sorted(remaining)}"
432:             )
433:     return ordered
434: 
435: 
436: _INDEX_SIZE = {"Generation": 3, "Colour": 3, "Gluon": 8, "SU2D": 2, "SU2W": 3}
437: 
438: 
439: def _block_entries(p: Parameter, sizes: Dict[str, int]) -> set:
440:     """The LHA entries (index tuples) an External parameter occupies in its block."""
441:     if not p.is_tensor:
442:         return {(p.order_block,)} if p.order_block is not None else set()
443:     entries = set()
444:     for r in p.value_rules:
445:         m = re.fullmatch(rf"\s*{re.escape(p.name)}\s*\[([0-9,\s]+)\]\s*", r.lhs)
446:         if m:
447:             entries.add(tuple(int(x) for x in m.group(1).split(",")))
448:     if entries:
449:         return entries
450:     ranges = [range(1, sizes.get(i, 3) + 1) for i in p.indices]
451:     out = {()}
452:     for rg in ranges:
453:         out = {e + (k,) for e in out for k in rg}
454:     return out
455: 
456: 
457: def _check_block_collisions(params: List[Parameter], sizes: Dict[str, int]) -> None:
458:     """External parameters that share an LHA block must not share an entry.
459: 
460:     FeynRules files an External tensor's entries under (block, i, j) and a
461:     scalar under (block, OrderBlock). Two parameters on one entry leave the UFO
462:     with one name defined twice, and MadGraph rejects the model ("name VLq1x1
463:     define multiple time"). Tensors of different rank in one block do not
464:     collide: GeneralU1's yN[i] and ynu[i,j] share a block and import cleanly.
465:     """
466:     by_block: Dict[str, List[Parameter]] = {}
467:     for p in params:
468:         if p.parameter_type == ParamType.External and p.block_name:
469:             by_block.setdefault(p.block_name, []).append(p)
470:     for block, ps in by_block.items():
471:         owner: Dict[tuple, str] = {}
472:         for p in ps:
473:             for e in sorted(_block_entries(p, sizes)):
474:                 if e in owner and owner[e] != p.name:
475:                     raise ValueError(
476:                         f"External parameters {owner[e]} and {p.name} both occupy "
477:                         f"block {block!r} entry {list(e)}: the UFO would define one "
478:                         "name twice. Give one of them its own block_name (or, for "
479:                         "scalars, its own order_block)"
480:                     )
481:                 owner[e] = p.name
482:

498:     lagrangian_terms: List[LagrangianTerm] = []
499:     # Verbatim escape hatches for irregular constructs (FR$LoopSwitches,
500:     # Mix[...] mixing blocks, SUSY superfields, ...).
501:     raw_preamble: List[str] = []  # emitted after M$Information, before IndexRange
502:     raw_blocks: List[str] = []  # emitted just before Lagrangian terms
503: 
504:     @model_validator(mode="after")
505:     def _check(self) -> "FeynRulesModel":
506:         labels = [p.class_label for p in self.particles]
507:         if len(labels) != len(set(labels)):
508:             dupes = sorted({x for x in labels if labels.count(x) > 1})
509:             raise ValueError(f"duplicate ParticleClass labels: {dupes}")
510:

521:         used = {i for p in self.particles for i in p.indices} | {
522:             i for prm in self.parameters for i in prm.indices
523:         }
524:         missing = used - declared

526:             raise ValueError(
527:                 f"indices used without an IndexRange declaration: {sorted(missing)}"

535:         names = [p.name for p in self.parameters]

537:         if dupes:

539:         sizes = dict(_INDEX_SIZE, **{d.name: d.size for d in self.index_decls})

by the ``.fr`` generator (render.py). Design principle: STRUCTURE the regular,

rationals like ``-1/3``, decimals like ``1500.``, scientific ``2.5*^-3``.

723:   LGhw = -ghWibar[ii].del[DC[ghWi[ii],mu],mu];
724:   LGhs = -ghGbar[ii].del[DC[ghG[ii],mu],mu];

728:   (* Vectorize transforms a doublet in a vector in the phi-basis, i.e. the basis of real degrees of freedom *)

738: ExpandIndices[ LGhs + If[FeynmanGauge, LGh1 + LGhw + LGhphi,0], FlavorExpand->SU2W]];

(* v1.4.6: NLO variable added.                                               *)

(*       Updated parameters to PDG 2010.                                     *)
(* v1.2: Set FeynmanGauge=True as default.                                   *)
(*       Set Gluonic ghosts to be included in both gauges.                   *)
(* v1.1: Fixed yukawa couplings in Feynman gauge.                            *)
(*       Changed yd[n] CKM[n,m] to yd[m] CKM[n,m].                           *)
(*       Changed yu[n] Conjugate[CKM[m,n]] to yu[m] Conjugate[CKM[m,n]].     *)

  SU2L == {

LGauge := Block[{mu,nu,ii,aa}, 
  ExpandIndices[-1/4 FS[B,mu,nu] FS[B,mu,nu] - 1/4 FS[Wi,mu,nu,ii] FS[Wi,mu,nu,ii] - 1/4 FS[G,mu,nu,aa] FS[G,mu,nu,aa], FlavorExpand->SU2W]];

LFermions := Block[{mu}, 
  ExpandIndices[I*(
    QLbar.Ga[mu].DC[QL, mu] + LLbar.Ga[mu].DC[LL, mu] + uRbar.Ga[mu].DC[uR, mu] + dRbar.Ga[mu].DC[dR, mu] + lRbar.Ga[mu].DC[lR, mu]), 
  FlavorExpand->{SU2W,SU2D}]/.{CKM[a_,b_] Conjugate[CKM[a_,c_]]->IndexDelta[b,c], CKM[b_,a_] Conjugate[CKM[c_,a_]]->IndexDelta[b,c]}];

LHiggs := Block[{ii,mu, feynmangaugerules},
  feynmangaugerules = If[Not[FeynmanGauge], {G0|GP|GPbar ->0}, {}];
 
  ExpandIndices[DC[Phibar[ii],mu] DC[Phi[ii],mu] + muH^2 Phibar[ii] Phi[ii] - lam Phibar[ii] Phi[ii] Phibar[jj] Phi[jj], FlavorExpand->{SU2D,SU2W}]/.feynmangaugerules
 ];

LYukawa := Block[{sp,ii,jj,cc,ff1,ff2,ff3,yuk,feynmangaugerules},
  feynmangaugerules = If[Not[FeynmanGauge], {G0|GP|GPbar ->0}, {}];
 
  yuk = ExpandIndices[
   -yd[ff2, ff3] CKM[ff1, ff2] QLbar[sp, ii, ff1, cc].dR [sp, ff3, cc] Phi[ii] - 
    yl[ff1, ff3] LLbar[sp, ii, ff1].lR [sp, ff3] Phi[ii] - 
    yu[ff1, ff2] QLbar[sp, ii, ff1, cc].uR [sp, ff2, cc] Phibar[jj] Eps[ii, jj], FlavorExpand -> SU2D];
  yuk = yuk /. { CKM[a_, b_] Conjugate[CKM[a_, c_]] -> IndexDelta[b, c], CKM[b_, a_] Conjugate[CKM[c_, a_]] -> IndexDelta[b, c]};
  yuk+HC[yuk]/.feynmangaugerules
 ];

LGhost := Block[{LGh1,LGhw,LGhs,LGhphi,mu, generators,gh,ghbar,Vectorize,phi1,phi2,togoldstones,doublet,doublet0},
  (* Pure gauge piece *) 	
  LGh1 = -ghBbar.del[DC[ghB,mu],mu];
  LGhw = -ghWibar[ii].del[DC[ghWi[ii],mu],mu];
  LGhs = -ghGbar[ii].del[DC[ghG[ii],mu],mu];

  (* Scalar pieces: see Peskin pages 739-742 *)
  (* phi1 and phi2 are the real degrees of freedom of GP *)
  (* Vectorize transforms a doublet in a vector in the phi-basis, i.e. the basis of real degrees of freedom *)
  gh    = {ghB, ghWi[1], ghWi[2], ghWi[3]};
  ghbar = {ghBbar, ghWibar[1], ghWibar[2], ghWibar[3]};
  generators = {-I/2 g1 IdentityMatrix[2], -I/2 gw PauliSigma[1], -I/2 gw PauliSigma[2], -I/2 gw PauliSigma[3]};
  doublet = Expand[{(-I phi1 - phi2)/Sqrt[2], Phi[2]} /. MR$Definitions /. vev -> 0]; 
  doublet0 = {0, vev/Sqrt[2]};
  Vectorize[{a_, b_}]:= Simplify[{Sqrt[2] Re[Expand[a]], Sqrt[2] Im[Expand[a]], Sqrt[2] Re[Expand[b]], Sqrt[2] Im[Expand[b]]}/.{Im[_]->0, Re[num_]->num}];
  togoldstones := {phi1 -> (GP + GPbar)/Sqrt[2], phi2 -> (-GP + GPbar)/(I Sqrt[2])};

135:     if m.value is not None:
136:         return f"{{{m.sym}, {_mw_value(m.value)}}}"

139: 
140: def _reps(reps: Sequence[Tuple[str, str]]) -> str:
141:     if len(reps) == 1:
142:         r, s = reps[0]
143:         return f"{{{r}, {s}}}"
144:     return "{" + ", ".join(f"{{{r}, {s}}}" for r, s in reps) + "}"
145: 
146: 
147: def _assoc(pairs: List[Tuple[str, Optional[str]]], indent: str = "    ") -> str:
148:     """Render ``{ Key -> val, ... }``, dropping entries whose value is None."""
149:     kept = [(k, v) for k, v in pairs if v is not None]
150:     if not kept:
151:         return "{}"
152:     inner = ",\n".join(f"{indent}{k} -> {v}" for k, v in kept)
153:     close_indent = indent[:-2] if len(indent) >= 2 else ""
154:     return "{\n" + inner + "\n" + close_indent + "}"
155: 
156: 
157: # ------------------------------ blocks ------------------------------- #
158: 
159: 
160: def render_information(info) -> str:
161:     pairs = [
162:         ("Authors", _strlist(info.authors)),
163:         ("Version", _quote(info.version)),
164:         ("Date", _quote(info.date)),
165:         ("Institutions", _strlist(info.institutions) if info.institutions else None),
166:         ("Emails", _strlist(info.emails) if info.emails else None),
167:     ]
168:     return "M$Information = " + _assoc(pairs, indent="  ") + ";"
169: 
170: 
171: def _render_gauge_group(g: GaugeGroup) -> str:
172:     pairs: List[Tuple[str, Optional[str]]] = [
173:         ("Abelian", _bool(g.abelian)),
174:         ("CouplingConstant", g.coupling_constant),
175:         ("GaugeBoson", g.gauge_boson),
176:         ("Charge", g.charge),
177:         ("StructureConstant", g.structure_constant),
178:         ("Representations", _reps(g.representations) if g.representations else None),
179:         ("SymmetricTensor", g.symmetric_tensor),
180:         (
181:             "Definitions",
182:             ("{" + ", ".join(g.definitions) + "}") if g.definitions else None,
183:         ),
184:     ]
185:     return f"  {g.name} == " + _assoc(pairs, indent="    ")
186: 
187: 
188: def render_gauge_groups(groups: List[GaugeGroup]) -> str:
189:     entries = ",\n".join(_render_gauge_group(g) for g in groups)
190:     return "M$GaugeGroups = {\n" + entries + "\n};"
191: 
192: 
193: def render_index_decls(decls: List[IndexDecl]) -> str:
194:     lines: List[str] = []
195:     for d in decls:
196:         if d.range_kind.value == "Range":
197:             rng = f"Range[{d.size}]"
198:         else:
199:             rng = f"{d.range_kind.value}[Range[{d.size}]]"
200:         lines.append(f"IndexRange[Index[{d.name}]] = {rng};")
201:     for d in decls:
202:         if d.style_symbol:
203:             lines.append(f"IndexStyle[{d.name}, {d.style_symbol}];")
204:     return "\n".join(lines)
205: 
206: 
207: def _render_parameter(p: Parameter) -> str:
208:     pairs: List[Tuple[str, Optional[str]]] = [
209:         ("ParameterType", p.parameter_type.value if p.parameter_type else None),
210:     ]
211:     if p.is_tensor:
212:         pairs.append(
213:             (
214:                 "Value",
215:                 ("{" + ", ".join(r.render() for r in p.value_rules) + "}")
216:                 if p.value_rules
217:                 else None,
218:             )
219:         )
220:         pairs.append(("Indices", _indices(p.indices)))
221:     else:
222:         pairs.append(("Value", p.value))
223:     pairs += [
224:         ("ComplexParameter", _bool(p.complex) if p.complex is not None else None),
225:         ("BlockName", p.block_name),
226:         ("OrderBlock", str(p.order_block) if p.order_block is not None else None),
227:         (
228:             "InteractionOrder",
229:             _interaction_order(p.interaction_order) if p.interaction_order else None,
230:         ),
231:         (
232:             "Definitions",
233:             ("{" + ", ".join(r.render() for r in p.definitions) + "}")
234:             if p.definitions
235:             else None,
236:         ),
237:         ("ParameterName", p.parameter_name),
238:         ("TensorClass", p.tensor_class),
239:         ("Unitary", _bool(p.unitary) if p.unitary is not None else None),
240:         ("Hermitian", _bool(p.hermitian) if p.hermitian is not None else None),
241:         ("Orthogonal", _bool(p.orthogonal) if p.orthogonal is not None else None),
242:         (
243:             "AllowSummation",
244:             _bool(p.allow_summation) if p.allow_summation is not None else None,
245:         ),
246:         # TeX is a LaTeX label; render it as a quoted Mathematica string with
247:         # backslashes escaped ("\\Gamma_U"), else a raw value like \Gamma_U is a
248:         # Mathematica syntax error that aborts the whole M$Parameters block.
249:         ("TeX", _quote(p.tex) if p.tex else None),
250:         ("Description", _quote(p.description) if p.description else None),
251:     ]
252:     return f"  {p.name} == " + _assoc(pairs, indent="    ")
253: 
254: 
255: def render_parameters(params: List[Parameter]) -> str:
256:     entries = ",\n".join(_render_parameter(p) for p in params)
257:     return "M$Parameters = {\n" + entries + "\n};"
258: 
259: 
260: def _render_particle(p: ParticleClass) -> str:
261:     pairs: List[Tuple[str, Optional[str]]] = [
262:         ("ClassName", p.class_name),
263:         ("SelfConjugate", _bool(p.self_conjugate)),
264:         (
265:             "ClassMembers",
266:             ("{" + ", ".join(p.class_members) + "}") if p.class_members else None,
267:         ),
268:         ("Indices", _indices(p.indices) if p.indices else None),
269:         ("FlavorIndex", p.flavor_index),
270:         ("Mass", _mass(p.mass) if p.mass else None),
271:         ("Width", _mass(p.width) if p.width else None),
272:         ("QuantumNumbers",
273:          _qn(p.quantum_numbers) if _additive_qns(p.quantum_numbers or {}) else None),
274:         ("PDG", _pdg(p.pdg) if p.pdg is not None else None),
275:         ("ParticleName", _name_field(p.particle_name) if p.particle_name else None),
276:         (
277:             "AntiParticleName",
278:             _name_field(p.antiparticle_name) if p.antiparticle_name else None,
279:         ),
280:         ("FullName", _name_field(p.full_name) if p.full_name else None),
281:         (
282:             "PropagatorLabel",
283:             _name_field(p.propagator_label) if p.propagator_label else None,
284:         ),
285:         ("PropagatorType", p.propagator_type.value if p.propagator_type else None),
286:         ("PropagatorArrow", p.propagator_arrow.value if p.propagator_arrow else None),
287:         ("Ghost", p.ghost),
288:         ("Goldstone", p.goldstone),
289:         ("Chirality", p.chirality),
290:         ("MajoranaPhase", p.majorana_phase),
291:         (
292:             "WeylComponents",
293:             ("{" + ", ".join(p.weyl_components) + "}") if p.weyl_components else None,
294:         ),
295:         ("Unphysical", _bool(True) if p.unphysical else None),
296:         (
297:             "Definitions",
298:             ("{" + ", ".join(p.definitions) + "}") if p.definitions else None,
299:         ),
300:     ]
301:     return f"  {p.class_label} == " + _assoc(pairs, indent="    ")
302: 
303: 
304: def render_classes(particles: List[ParticleClass]) -> str:
305:     entries = ",\n".join(_render_particle(p) for p in particles)
306:     return "M$ClassesDescription = {\n" + entries + "\n};"
307: 
308: 
309: def render_model(model: FeynRulesModel) -> str:
310:     """Render a validated FeynRulesModel to a complete ``.fr`` string."""
311:     sections: List[str] = [render_information(model.info)]
312: 
313:     if model.interaction_order_hierarchy:
314:         ih = ", ".join(_interaction_order(t) for t in model.interaction_order_hierarchy)
315:         sections.append("M$InteractionOrderHierarchy = {" + ih + "};")
316:     if model.interaction_order_limit:
317:         il = ", ".join(_interaction_order(t) for t in model.interaction_order_limit)
318:         sections.append("M$InteractionOrderLimit = {" + il + "};")
319:     if model.feynman_gauge is not None:
320:         sections.append(f"FeynmanGauge = {_bool(model.feynman_gauge)};")
321:     if model.vevs:
322:         vv = ", ".join(f"{{{f}, {v}}}" for f, v in model.vevs)
323:         sections.append("M$vevs = {" + vv + "};")
324: 
325:     for raw in model.raw_preamble:
326:         sections.append(raw)
327: 
328:     if model.index_decls:
329:         sections.append(render_index_decls(model.index_decls))
330:     if model.gauge_groups:
331:         sections.append(render_gauge_groups(model.gauge_groups))
332:     if model.parameters:
333:         # FeynRules auto-declares the mass/width parameters named in each
334:         # particle's Mass/Width spec. Re-declaring them in M$Parameters makes the
335:         # UFO define the name twice, which MadGraph rejects ("name X define
336:         # multiple time"). Drop those duplicates; keep genuine couplings.
337:         reserved = _reserved_mass_width_names(model.particles)
338:         params = [p for p in model.parameters
339:                   if p.name not in reserved or _is_internal_param(p)]
340:         if params:
341:             sections.append(render_parameters(params))
342:     if model.particles:
343:         sections.append(render_classes(model.particles))
344:     for field, expr in model.gauge_xi:
345:         sections.append(f"GaugeXi[{field}] = {expr};")
346: 
347:     for raw in model.raw_blocks:
348:         sections.append(raw)
349: 
350:     for t in model.lagrangian_terms:
351:         op = ":=" if t.delayed else "="
352:         # Defensive: some (LLM-produced) expressions already carry a leading
353:         # assignment operator ("= ..." or ":= ..."); strip it so we don't emit a
354:         # duplicated operator (e.g. "L := := Block[...]").
355:         rhs = t.expression.lstrip()
356:         for lead in (":=", "="):
357:             if rhs.startswith(lead):
358:                 rhs = rhs[len(lead):].lstrip()
359:                 break
360:         sections.append(f"{t.name} {op} {rhs};")
361: 
362:     env = Environment(
363:         loader=FileSystemLoader(_TEMPLATE_DIR),
364:         autoescape=select_autoescape(enabled_extensions=(), default=False),
365:         keep_trailing_newline=True,
366:     )
367:     template = env.get_template("model.fr.j2")
368:     return template.render(model_name=model.model_name, body="\n\n".join(sections))
